widget.name: HTML PDF Export View
widget.description: Transparent export boundary for rendered Mendix content.

property.caption: Content
property.description: Widgets inside the export boundary. Current View captures only the content currently rendered here; FullData scopes use the configured report integration.

property.caption: Export Format
property.description: Selects the output format. PDF targets fixed visual fidelity; Word creates editable semantic content. PDF is the default. Current View Word exports use a cleaned editable representation, while FullData Word exports use the application-supplied JSON and FreeMarker template.

property.caption: Appearance Mode
property.description: Exact View is the highest-fidelity screen representation and preserves layout, controls, colors, spacing, current form state, and Mendix/Atlas/custom styling. Clean Report preserves that styling and source layout but converts values to printable content and removes safe interaction-only controls; it does not rebuild the page.

property.caption: Export Scope
property.description: Current View exports only content currently rendered inside the boundary; it does not click pages or load virtualized records. All Filtered exports the complete filtered dataset supplied by the host application, independently of UI pagination. Selected exports the dataset selected and supplied by the host. FullData scopes require Report JSON, Template Content, and a FullData Export Action and never fall back silently to Current View.

property.caption: PDF Orientation
property.description: Portrait produces vertical A4 output and is the default. Landscape produces horizontal A4 output. Auto chooses from captured source geometry. Exact View establishes the source layout first, then proportionally fits it into the selected orientation before Chromium renders the PDF.

property.caption: Show Export Button
property.description: Shows the widget's compact runtime export control. Disable it when export is triggered by another page control; the widget UI is always excluded from captured output.

property.caption: Export Button Caption
property.description: Accessible text displayed on the primary runtime export button. The default is Export PDF.

property.caption: Show Runtime Appearance Selector
property.description: Allows users to choose Exact View or Clean Report for the current component session. Disabled by default because appearance is application-specific; it changes no permanent Studio Pro configuration.

property.caption: Show Runtime Scope Selector
property.description: Allows users to choose Current View, All Filtered, or Selected. Disabled by default. FullData choices are disabled when their required JSON, template, or action is unavailable and never fall back to Current View.

property.caption: Show Runtime Orientation Selector
property.description: Allows users to choose Portrait, Landscape, or Auto before export. Enabled by default. The choice controls orientation metadata before Chromium rendering and does not rotate a completed PDF.

property.caption: Show Runtime Format Selector
property.description: Allows users to choose PDF or Word for the current component session. Disabled by default to keep the runtime UI compact. It overrides the Studio Pro Export Format without changing permanent configuration.

property.caption: Current View Export Action
property.description: Optional action executed after Current View creates the complete standalone HTML document. Map HtmlContent to the existing PDF conversion flow. Leave empty only when an HTML download without an application action is intended.

property.caption: Current View Word Export Action
property.description: Application action for Current View Word export. It receives cleaned standalone semantic HTML plus Portrait, Landscape, or Auto orientation and should store the generated .docx in a System.FileDocument. Leave empty only when Word format is unavailable.

property.caption: Report JSON
property.description: Application-defined JSON model consumed by the FullData FreeMarker template, for example { "report": { "title": "Monthly Report" }, "rows": [...] }. Current View does not use this property. All Filtered and Selected normally require it.

property.caption: Template Content
property.description: FreeMarker HTML template that combines Report JSON with HTML and CSS before Chromium PDF rendering. This FullData template is separate from Current View DOM capture and is required for All Filtered and Selected.

property.caption: FullData Export Action
property.description: Application integration point for All Filtered and Selected. The host supplies the complete intended report independently from visible UI pagination. Map ReportJson, TemplateContent, ExportScope, and batching values to the FullData Java Action; this contract is generic and not DataGrid2-specific.

property.caption: FullData Word Export Action
property.description: Application integration point for All Filtered and Selected Word exports. It receives complete application-supplied Report JSON, FreeMarker template, scope, and orientation; it is independent from DataGrid pagination and never falls back to Current View.

property.caption: Batch Mode
property.description: Off renders the complete FullData collection in one Chromium operation. Auto, the default, batches when the configured collection exceeds Batch Size. Always currently applies the same deterministic threshold behavior. Batching reduces per-render pressure and merges temporary PDFs into one output.

property.caption: Batch Size
property.description: Maximum records rendered in one FullData Chromium batch. Default 5000 is conservative and tested. Smaller values reduce per-render pressure but create more temporary PDFs; larger values reduce batch count but increase Chromium resource pressure. No value is guaranteed safe on every environment. Allowed range: 100 through 25000.

property.caption: Batch Collection Path
property.description: Dotted path to the application-defined JSON array to batch, such as rows, report.rows, data.transactions, or data.employees. The target must resolve to an array and does not need to be named rows. Required when batching is not Off.

property.caption: Current View HTML File Name
property.description: File name used by the optional browser HTML download in Current View, including an .html extension. It does not name the server-created PDF. Default: export.html.

property.caption: Include Styles
property.description: Collects accessible page stylesheets, including Atlas, compiled theme SCSS, custom CSS, variables, fonts, colors, flex, and grid rules. Enabled by default; disabling it reduces Current View visual fidelity.

property.caption: Include Images
property.description: Retains image and inline SVG content and serializes accessible canvases in Current View. Enabled by default. Cross-origin canvas restrictions may prevent individual canvas serialization.

property.caption: Debug Mode
property.description: Logs technical metadata such as captured dimensions, selected orientation, scale, export scope, and batching configuration. Disabled by default. It never logs business JSON, HTML contents, form values, report data, or document text.
